spans.text: Lonely footsteps echo through the empty underground facility... as she staggers... stumbles...
Kalina braces herself against the wall, walking forward with vacant eyes...
Half an hour has passed since the Commander was taken away.
The underground passages, once noisy and chaotic, now hold only her solitary figure.
After waking as if from a dream, comes the numb confusion of facing reality alone...
Kalina comes to a stop. This is the place where Tokarev and the others fought with their lives to send her into the tunnel.
Mechanical debris litters the ground—shattered parts, broken limbs. Scattered sparks flash in the half-darkness, accompanied by the occasional crackle of electricity.
Tokarev... C14...
Everyone...
Kalina collapses to the ground. She keeps searching frantically, trying to find their frames.
But the dim lighting, combined with her exhaustion and dizziness, makes it almost impossible to see anything clearly...
She searches again and again, yet there is no trace of her former companions.
She dragged them into this. Not only has she failed to save the Commander, she also pulled them—who should have returned to normal lives—into this nightmare...
If it hadn't been for her... or if she had noticed the deception behind all this just a little earlier... would none of this have happened?
She has no answer.
I'm sorry...
I'm so sorry, everyone... This is all my fault... (Sobs)
(Rustle) (Scrape)
As Kalina bows her head and sobs, in a corner she hasn't noticed, an autonomous Doll opens its eyes.
It's my fault... I never should have woken you up... I never should have dragged you into this... (Sobs)
The autonomous Doll twitches. Its torso isn't badly damaged, only one arm has been blown off. The rest of its body remains intact.
(Rustle) (Scrape)
(Rustle)
With little effort, it pushes itself upright and locks onto the source of the sobbing.
A defeated shell, her soul drowning in pain, her guard lowered against her surroundings.
An easy opportunity. A defenseless prey...
If it takes her down now, then to those with ill intent, this would be the most satisfying ending imaginable...
The autonomous Doll trembles as it raises its remaining arm, taking a one-handed firing stance.
Click.
Huh...?
In the deathly silent space, the sound of a rifle bolt being pulled rings out. Even swallowed by grief, Kalina instantly senses the abnormal—and dangerous—noise.
But when she turns her head and finds herself staring into a pitch-black muzzle, it is already too late.
Kalina's pupils dilate. In sheer terror, she instinctively holds her breath.
The gun fires. Kalina shuts her eyes out of reflex.
Then she hears the sound of a body hitting the ground...
She opens her eyes cautiously. She is unharmed.
The autonomous Doll that fired moments ago now lies on its back, completely motionless.
Huh?!
Isn't it a bit early to be bawling your eyes out?
Footsteps sound behind her. Kalina turns around in shock. A figure emerges from the darkness.
The face that comes into view bears a long scar carved across the left eye.
Seeing that scar, Kalina cries out in disbelief and joy.
Mhmm, it's me~
Long time no see, Kalin.
Why... why are you here...? Where did you go?!
J-just now, the Commander... the Commander...
Alright, alright. I know you've got a million questions, but this isn't the place to talk.
I can only tell you this—the Commander is definitely safe right now. And...
UMP45 steps closer, helps Kalina to her feet, and carefully brushes the dust from her clothes.
...We've got work to do.
Kalina stares at her in a daze. 45 grabs her by the arm and leads her into the darkness.
